title: The Paranoid Senior
subtitle: Marcus spots code anomalies immediately. Secretly manipulate his smart home to physically distract him.

concepts.name: Cyber-Physical Pivoting & Out-of-Band Human Distraction
concepts.hint: Exploit flat home network subnets to physically distract an operator.
concepts.explanation: Advanced adversaries exploit unsegmented flat network topologies—such as IoT devices connected to developer subnets—to induce real-world physical distractions (noise, temperature changes, alarms). Diverting human attention out-of-band allows malicious operations to bypass manual review gates and live monitoring.

concepts.name: Human-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection & Attention Fatigue
concepts.hint: Induce cognitive sensory overload to degrade operator audit acuity.
concepts.explanation: Experienced security practitioners rely on heuristic intuition, side-channel timing, and subtle metric deviations rather than static automated rules. Defeating human-in-the-loop defense requires managing the operator’s cognitive load, environmental comfort, and psychological fatigue.

concepts.name: Living Off The Land (LOLBins) & Kernel Observability Evasion
concepts.hint: Blend execution into native diagnostic tools (perf, bpftool, ss).
concepts.explanation: When operating under strict surveillance by senior engineers, dropping custom binaries immediately triggers alerting. Adversaries employ legitimate administrative utilities (perf, bpftool, ss, curl) and camouflage kernel hooks within standard telemetry frameworks (eBPF, systemd cgroups) to blend into baseline noise.

concepts.name: Hardware & Ring-0 Firmware Persistence
concepts.hint: Evade OS-level eBPF tracing by establishing storage controller firmware hooks.
concepts.explanation: When kernel-level tracing (eBPF) monitors all system calls, persistence can drop below the OS into NVMe controller microcode or Option ROMs, surviving complete operating system re-installations.

concepts.name: Network Microsegmentation & Zero Trust IoT
concepts.hint: Expose vulnerabilities in home office perimeter and IoT segregation.
concepts.explanation: Remote work expands enterprise attack surfaces into unmanaged domestic environments. Enforcing microsegmentation and 802.1X device isolation prevents smart appliances from compromising development workstations.

cybersecurityLessons.explanation: Advanced adversaries exploit unsegmented flat network topologies—such as IoT devices connected to developer subnets—to induce real-world physical distractions (noise, temperature changes, alarms). Diverting human attention out-of-band allows malicious operations to bypass manual review gates and live monitoring.

cybersecurityLessons.principle: Living Off The Land (LOLBins) & Kernel Observability Evasion
cybersecurityLessons.explanation: When operating under strict surveillance by senior engineers, dropping custom binaries immediately triggers alerting. Adversaries employ legitimate administrative utilities (perf, bpftool, ss, curl) and camouflage kernel hooks within standard telemetry frameworks (eBPF, systemd cgroups) to blend into baseline noise.

Experienced security practitioners rely on heuristic intuition, side-channel timing, and subtle metric deviations rather than static automated rules. Defeating human-in-the-loop defense requires managing the operator’s cognitive load, environmental comfort, and psychological fatigue.
